en: The front side of the postcard features a black-and-white stereoscopic photograph showing a riverside landscape with a church in the distance. The church is labeled 'Stöde kyrka,' and the view also includes a bridge, rural buildings, trees, and mountains in the background. The reverse side is a blank traditional postcard layout with lines for address and a dividing line, plus handwritten notes, the printed words 'UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE CARTE POSTALE,' and the photographer's mark: 'Photo. Axel Rydin, Stockholm.'
